name: synascriber
description: Written notes of Jitsi meetings in openDesk. Speech becomes text on your organisation's servers; audio is not kept.
author: metadist

routes.description: Public: where Keycloak returns after the Jitsi button's sign-in; hands the code to the Jitsi window named in jitsi_url
Plugin on/off, languages, folder, and the room's active notes (Jitsi loader, Keycloak bearer)
Start meeting notes in a room
Meeting notes started by the signed-in person
Transcriber: bind to an active session (owner API key)
Transcriber: one audio window (Ogg Opus) for one speaker
Transcriber: the bridge closed; write the transcript
